#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?target path required}"

TomlQuote() {
  local value="${1-}"
  value=${value//\\/\\\\}; value=${value//\"/\\\"}
  value=${value//$'\r'/\\r}; value=${value//$'\n'/\\n}; value=${value//$'\t'/\\t}
  printf '"%s"' "$value"
}
ReadExistingSecret() { [ -f "$1" ] || return 0; sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*shared_secret[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\([0-9A-Fa-f]*\)"[[:space:]]*$/\1/p' "$1" | head -n 1; }
NewRandomSecret() { od -An -N32 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n'; }
ResolveSecret() {
  local panel="$1" existing="$2" lower
  panel="$(printf '%s' "$panel" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')"; lower="$(printf '%s' "$panel" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
  case "$lower" in change-me*|paste*secret*|shared-secret|shared_secret|"shared secret"|your-secret|your_secret|"your secret"|replace-me*) echo 'The shared secret is a documented placeholder, not a usable secret' >&2; return 1;; esac
  if [ -n "$panel" ]; then printf '%s' "$panel"; elif [ -n "$existing" ]; then printf '%s' "$existing"; else NewRandomSecret; fi
}
ParsePort() { local value="$1" name="$2"; [[ "$value" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( value >= 1 && value <= 65535 )) || { echo "$name must be from 1 through 65535" >&2; return 1; }; printf '%s' "$value"; }
ParseBool() { local value="${1,,}" name="$2"; case "$value" in true|false) printf '%s' "$value";; *) echo "$name must be true or false" >&2; return 1;; esac; }
WriteAtomic() { local path="$1" content="$2" directory temporary; directory="$(dirname "$path")"; mkdir -p "$directory"; temporary="$directory/.$(basename "$path").$$.$RANDOM.tmp"; trap 'rm -f "$temporary"' RETURN; printf '%s' "$content" > "$temporary"; mv -f "$temporary" "$path"; trap - RETURN; }

registry_port="$(ParsePort "${NR_REGISTRY_PORT:-8765}" 'Registry port')"
public_port="$(ParsePort "${NR_PUBLIC_PORT:-42420}" 'Proxy public port')"
advertise="$(ParseBool "${NR_ADVERTISE:-false}" 'Master-server advertising')"
has_password="$(ParseBool "${NR_HAS_PASSWORD:-false}" 'Password listing flag')"
whitelisted="$(ParseBool "${NR_WHITELISTED:-false}" 'Whitelist listing flag')"
public_host="${NR_PUBLIC_HOST-}"; game_version="${NR_GAME_VERSION:-1.22.6}"
if [ "$advertise" = true ]; then [ -n "$public_host" ] || { echo 'Advertising requires the public hostname or IP of Nimbus Proxy' >&2; exit 1; }; [ -n "$game_version" ] || { echo 'Advertising requires the Vintage Story game version supported by the selected Stratum release' >&2; exit 1; }; fi
secret="$(ResolveSecret "${NR_SHARED_SECRET:-}" "$(ReadExistingSecret "$target")")"

content="bind_url = $(TomlQuote "http://${NR_BIND_ADDRESS:-0.0.0.0}:${registry_port}")
shared_secret = $(TomlQuote "$secret")
accepted_secrets = []
backend_stale_seconds = 20
backend_drop_seconds = 120
nonce_window_seconds = 90
max_reservation_ttl_seconds = 300
log_heartbeats = false
state_dir = \".\"

[api_tokens]
enabled = false
rate_limit_per_minute = 60
trust_forwarded_proto = false

[identity]
advertise_on_master_server = ${advertise}
master_server_url = \"http://masterserver.vintagestory.at/api/v1/servers/\"
public_host = $(TomlQuote "$public_host")
public_port = ${public_port}
server_name = $(TomlQuote "${NR_SERVER_NAME:-Nimbus Network}")
server_description = $(TomlQuote "${NR_SERVER_DESCRIPTION:-}")
server_url = \"\"
server_icon = \"\"
vh_identifier = \"\"
game_version = $(TomlQuote "$game_version")
max_players_override = 0
mod_source = \"aggregate\"
explicit_mods = []
whitelisted = ${whitelisted}
has_password = ${has_password}
heartbeat_interval_seconds = 120

[identity.playstyle]
id = \"surviveandbuild\"
lang_code = \"preset-surviveandbuild\"
"
WriteAtomic "$target" "$content"
printf 'wrote %s\n' "$target"
